winter.name: Winter
winter.line: Ski slopes on Buková hora and cross-country trails along the ridge.
winter.text: You can ski on both sides of Buková hora. The Čenkovice slopes are linked to the ski area in Červená Voda: the Čenkovice side is gentler and shorter, the Červená Voda side longer and sportier. Tows and a two-seater chairlift take you up from Čenkovice, a heated chairlift from Červená Voda. Cross-country skiers have ridge trails around Buková hora and Suchý vrch.

spring.name: Spring
spring.line: Spring snowflakes in the Čenkovička valley and hikes without the crowds.
spring.text: Walks without the crowds. Spring snowflakes bloom in the Čenkovička valley; please do not pick them. While the trees are still bare, the military bunkers and pre-war fortifications are easy to spot in the forests. In May we recommend a walk to the Bouda artillery fortress.

summer.name: Summer
summer.line: By bike to Suchý vrch and along the trails around Buková hora.
summer.text: Hike or cycle up Suchý vrch, stop for refreshments at the Kramářova chata and look out from the tower as far as the Jeseníky and the Krkonoše. The area around Buková hora is full of cycle routes and trails. Children have minigolf and a playground in the village, and the local restaurant has a family atmosphere and friendly prices.

autumn.name: Autumn
autumn.line: Mushrooms just behind the cottages and beech forests in full colour.
autumn.text: Mushrooms grow just behind the cottages. The access road is lined with colourful maples and the surrounding beech forests turn every shade. Spend the day at the Military Museum in Králíky and among the bunkers, and the evening in the sauna.

home.lead: Rychta Čenkovice is a mountain house in the Orlické hory for families and large groups. 34 beds, a common room with a wood-burning stove, saunas and a hot tub under the open sky.

welcome.title: Together at one table, each in your own apartment
text: Discover a place where mountain nature, time together and comfort meet. We set the Rychta up for people who want to spend time with family or friends without giving up their own peace.
Every apartment has its own kitchen and bathroom. A big table for everyone, a wood-burning stove and a billiards table are waiting in the common room.

privacy.title: Privacy policy

sections.title: Who processes your data
text: The data controller is the operator of the Rychta Čenkovice accommodation, Čenkovice 106, 561 64 Čenkovice, Czechia. Contact: rychtacenkovice@seznam.cz, +420 606 734 911.

We take the protection of personal data seriously. We process data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Czech Act No. 110/2019 Coll. on personal data processing, and Act No. 127/2005 Coll. on electronic communications.

sections.title: What we collect and why
text: When you send us a message or a booking request, we process your name, e-mail, phone number, dates of stay, number of guests and the text of your message. We need them to reply to you, confirm the booking and arrange your stay.
We keep the data only for as long as it takes to handle the request, arrange the stay and meet our legal obligations.

sections.title: Who we share data with
text: We do not pass the data you send us in a form (name, contact details, dates of stay and the text of your message) on to third parties.

sections.title: Cookies
text: This website uses no advertising or analytics cookies and does not track you. Without your consent we only store your choice from the cookie settings in your browser. If you allow it, we also remember your chosen language.
The administration uses one technical cookie needed to keep the administrator signed in securely and remembers the language the administrator chose.

sections.title: Your rights
text: You have the right to access your data, to have it corrected or erased, to restrict its processing and to data portability. Just write to rychtacenkovice@seznam.cz. You can lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (uoou.gov.cz).

trips.name: Suchý vrch
trips.text: Just under 2 hours on foot, about 12 minutes by car. A lookout tower in a former water tower with views of Králický Sněžník, the Orlické hory and the Jeseníky. A restaurant and a snack bar stand next to it.

trips.name: Jablonné nad Orlicí
trips.text: A square with timber houses, a brewery, a pizzeria and an outdoor pool. Heritage steam trains stop here in season.

trips.name: Křížová hora lookout tower
trips.text: Above Červená Voda, about 19 minutes by car. A Way of the Cross and a concrete lookout tower.

trips.name: Val lookout tower
trips.text: On Val hill by Dolní Hedeč, about 3 km from Králíky. A telecommunications tower with a viewing gallery 22 m up, reached by 102 steps. Open all year.

trips.name: Museum of Crafts, Letohrad
trips.text: The largest crafts museum in Czechia, in the Nový dvůr farmstead from 1750. Dozens of workshops and trades from 1840 to 1930, a moving model with carved figures of craftsmen, a frame sawmill and an old school classroom. Craft Saturdays with demonstrations and children’s workshops in summer.

trips.name: Babiččin statek farm
trips.text: A farm in Líšnice in the foothills of the Orlické hory. Farm animals, a nature trail and playgrounds for children. Open in season.

trips.name: Hora Matky Boží monastery (Hedeč)
trips.text: A pilgrimage avenue of lime trees and a Way of the Cross from Králíky.

trips.name: Žamberk
trips.text: Outdoor pool, Museum of Steam Engines and Cars, castle park.

trips.name: Pastviny reservoir
trips.text: A reservoir on the Divoká Orlice, built from 1932 to 1938, with one of the last hand-built stone dams in Bohemia. Free swimming in summer, with campsites and restaurants by the water.

trips.name: Klepáč lookout tower
trips.text: The Three Seas summit (1,145 m) on the Polish border, where the Baltic, North Sea and Black Sea watersheds meet. The lookout tower, built in 2009 and 2010 with a platform 22 m up, stands a few metres inside Poland.

trips.name: Dolní Morava
trips.text: Sky Walk, Sky Bridge 721, the Mammoth children's parks, the Mammoth alpine coaster and a trail park.

trips.name: Králický Sněžník
trips.text: A lookout tower, the baby elephant statue below the summit and the source of the Morava river.

trips.name: Zemská brána
trips.text: About 35 minutes by car. The valley of the Divoká Orlice with an easy nature trail past the Smugglers' Footbridge and the Ledříkovy caves.

trips.name: Church in Neratov
trips.text: The Church of the Assumption with its unique glass roof. A brewery, a pub, a garden centre and the Miraculous Spring.

trips.name: Litomyšl
trips.text: A UNESCO-listed château, the Monastery Gardens, a Gothic and Renaissance square, the Piarist church and a swimming pool.

trips.name: Nové Hrady château near Litomyšl
trips.text: Nicknamed the Czech Versailles. A château tour, gardens with mazes and a garden theatre, the Museum of Cycling and the Museum of Hats.

trips.name: Častolovice château
trips.text: A Renaissance château still lived in by the Sternberg family. Guided tours of the interiors in season. A park in the Bělá valley, open all year, where white fallow deer roam freely, and an animal enclosure with llamas, alpacas and ponies.

resorts.name: Singletrack Suchák
resorts.text: Forest singletrack between Červená Voda and Orličky. Colour-coded loops of varying difficulty.

resorts.name: Buková hora mountain resort
resorts.text: Buková hora right above Čenkovice, reached on foot or by chairlift. Views from the top and a link to the resort in Červená Voda, in winter and in summer.

resorts.name: Bouda fortress
resorts.text: Along a forest path from Suchý vrch. The best-preserved Czechoslovak fortress, built in 1935 and fully accessible with a guide. It is 4 to 6 °C underground all year, so bring warm clothes.

resorts.name: Hůrka fortress
resorts.text: An artillery fortress on the northern edge of Králíky, built from 1935 to 1938 and open to the public since 2008. Guided tours only; the main underground route is about 1.4 km long and takes over an hour. Includes an exhibition on Czechoslovak paratroopers.

resorts.name: Military Museum Králíky
resorts.text: In Prostřední Lipka near Králíky. An exhibition hall on the history of the Czechoslovak army from the First World War to today: tanks, self-propelled and field guns, infantry fighting vehicles and a replica of an interwar army barrack room. Tank rides in summer.

resorts.name: Dolní Morava
resorts.text: Sky Bridge 721, the longest pedestrian suspension bridge in the world, is walked in one direction. The Sky Walk is a 55 m tall wooden structure with a net at the top and a 100 m slide down. The Mammoth alpine coaster is the longest in Czechia: 3 km, 25 bends, a 360° turn and an underground tunnel, and you control the speed with the brake.

resorts.name: Červenovodské sedlo pass
resorts.text: The starting point for bike trips and ridge hikes, and for cross-country trails in winter. A large car park on the border of Bohemia and Moravia.

resorts.name: 3D map of the bike region
resorts.text: An interactive 3D map of the bike routes and trails around. Handy for planning a ride.
